title: Oak Dale food pantry’s next date is Saturday, Oct. 17
excerpt: Oak Dale’s third-Saturday pantry schedule points to Oct. 17, noon–2 p.m., at 7230 Highway 346 in Pontotoc. The notice lists nonperishable food only.
locality: Oak Dale Baptist Church, 7230 Highway 346, Pontotoc, Mississippi 38863, in the Hurricane community.

facts.statement: The church notice lists its food pantry every third Saturday from noon to 2 p.m.; October’s third Saturday falls on October 17, 2026.
facts.evidence: The preparing assistant opened the original public church page in Chrome without signing in, dismissed the login invitation, opened its current public post, and inspected the complete flyer pixels. It reads EVERY 3RD SATURDAY / 12:00–2:00 P.M. The same complete flyer linked by the exact October 14 Town of Ecru saved-feed entry was downloaded HTTP 200 and independently inspected. The original post canonical numeric URL, obtained from its own og:url metadata, returned HTTP 200 through unchanged Transport.public. The saved feed also returned HTTP 200 and contained the exact Town permalink. Calendar arithmetic, not an extra organizer statement, supplies October 17.
facts.date_context: The Town of Ecru shared the current notice October 14, 2026 at 16:53:09 UTC (11:53 a.m. CDT). On October 16 the original public church post visibly said 3 days ago; its exact publication timestamp was not established, so published_at is null. The source flyer gives every 3rd Saturday, 12:00–2:00 P.M. Python calendar.monthcalendar(2026,10) confirms October Saturdays 3,10,17,24,31; October 17 is the third. October 17 is derived explicitly from the recurring rule and current month, not transcribed as a printed date. Hours are posted local America/Chicago (CDT).
facts.locality: Oak Dale Baptist Church, 7230 Highway 346, Pontotoc, Mississippi 38863, in the Hurricane community.
facts.identities: Oak Dale Baptist Church is the organizer in the Hurricane community at the Pontotoc postal address shown. The Town of Ecru shared the same pantry notice; it is not described as the organizer. No private individual or food recipient is identified.
facts.statistics: Third Saturday; two-hour advertised window, noon–2 p.m.; October 17, 2026 is the calculated current-month date. No year is assigned to a stale annual graphic.
